cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30007-r1 --slot 21 --why "slot 21 gives near-maximal separation across seven pairs at once including the two runner-up candidates against the weaker ones, the earliest broad cleanup point"

content.text:
Campaign complete for case-30007.

**Outcome: abstained** (correctly, per protocol).

- Used all 6 observation slots, targeting broad multi-pair discriminators early (slots 3, 7, 18) then converging on the leading pair (candidates 1 vs 3) as it separated (slots 21, 23, 30).
- Candidate 1 (P≈13.52 d) emerged as the clear leader, rising to a peak support of 0.743 after slot 23, but the confirmation observation at slot 30 pulled it back to 0.670 — well short of the θ=0.997 resolution threshold.
- With budget exhausted and no slot left to close the gap, finalized with an honest abstention rather than overclaiming resolution.
